domain_focus: MAVEN-ERE v1.7: frozen high-recall event inventory; PRECONDITION-aware high-recall relation graph followed by calibrated directed adjudication.
abstraction_level: Layer 1 remains frozen/reused from v1.4. Layer 2 keeps mention anchors distinct, proposes dependencies in three complementary whole-document passes, and performs one calibrated PRECONDITION/CAUSE adjudication without a destructive skeptic cascade.
population_policy: Preserve all v1.4 event mentions. PRECONDITION may be direct or strongly implicit through enabling, purpose, plan, process, initiation/completion, or structural dependency when grounded in the document. CAUSE remains narrower. Gold is unavailable until post-L12 diagnostics/evaluation.
event_modeling_preference: Use the shortest complete exact trigger; retain genuine multi-token predicates such as took place; do not conflate entity mentions with events.

negative_examples.text: A relation inferred only from world knowledge with no document support.
